limits: Timings include real model execution, transfers, synchronization and NPU packing/scatter; validation and tracing are absent from timed profiles.
Generated output counts vary. Full-answer/decode times are observations, not controlled equal-output speed comparisons.
The 15,512-token and all-widths screens have one observation per arm; only the separately identified confirmation has three alternating pairs.
Bounded arithmetic, first-window logits, JSON and ledger/cache checks are not held-out perplexity, general quality equivalence, full64K, vision or concurrent-client qualification.
Mapped CUDA/XRT host buffers still require discrete-GPU PCIe traffic. Whole projection weights reside in host RAM; the kernel reuses tiles in SRAM.

CUDA reports a low WDDM allocation budget on both control and candidate. Dedicated-VRAM floors were monitored separately; host mappings/shared-memory counters are not proof of VRAM paging or its absence.
The tested kernel uses16compute workers. These measurements do not establish maximum physical tile count, issue width, SRAM bandwidth or the best possible NPU implementation.
